title: PSGC — Barangays in the City of Dagupan (0105518000)
notes: Release date 13 July 2026, announced as "Second Quarter 2026 PSGC Updates". The dataset itself is stated as "Philippine Standard Geographic Code as of 30 June 2026", which is why the release date and the reference date are recorded separately. The page separately states "There are 31 barangays as of 31 July 2025"; that is a third date and applies to the count, not to the codes or population figures. Authoritative for the current barangay names, PSGC codes, urban/rural classification and 2024 POPCEN population. The equivalent bulk file is PSGC-2Q-2026-Publication-Datafile.xlsx.

title: Barangay Captains (2018–2020)
licence: Public domain unless otherwise stated (site footer)
notes: A historical page: its table is explicitly headed "2018– 2020". It is cited only as the origin of four barangay-name spellings observed there, and those spellings are labelled historical wherever they appear. It is not evidence that any spelling is current, and no official named on it is published anywhere in this repository.

agency: Department of the Interior and Local Government
title: Masterlist of Barangays
notes: Catalogued as a derivative source only. DILG redistributes the PSA PSGC publication rather than maintaining an independent roster, so it is not independent corroboration of the names, codes, classifications or population figures. The PSA dataset remains authoritative for all of those. No field is taken from here and no record cites it.

title: Directory
licence: Copyright © 2023 City Government of Dagupan. All Rights Reserved. (site footer)
notes: One of three department rosters the city publishes simultaneously, all of them live and none carrying a date in its content. Its table is headed "Contact Person | Office/Department | Contact Number" and lists 33 city offices plus PNP, BFP, Red Cross, PANDA Volunteers, DECORP and PAMANA, followed by a second table of 14 emergency hotlines. It is the only page publishing an office address: "2F Dagupan City Hall Complex, AB Fernandez Ave., Dagupan City" for the City Mayor's Office and the City Information Office. The CMS reports article:modified_time 2026-07-14T06:16:03Z, but every department page on the site was re-saved within 70 minutes that day and the newest stamp belongs to the most obviously superseded roster, so that timestamp records a bulk re-save rather than editorial currency and is deliberately NOT recorded as `published`. Agrees with the Officials-section roster except on the City Information Office head and four City Health Office numbers.

title: Department Heads — Officials section
licence: Copyright © 2023 City Government of Dagupan. All Rights Reserved. (site footer)
notes: A near-clone of the Directory page in markup and wording, listing three offices the Directory omits: the General Services Office, the Youth and Sports Development Program and the Bids and Awards Committee. It omits the four non-government entities the Directory carries. Two disagreements with the Directory: it names the City Information Office head "Dave M. Paragas" where the Directory says "Divino M. Paragas", and gives the City Health Office "(075) 637-4920" where the Directory gives "(075) 522-8206" and "0933-861-6088". Its title as published is simply "Department Heads"; "Officials section" is appended here only to distinguish it from the identically titled page under /the-city/. CMS article:modified_time 2026-07-14T05:27:30Z, not treated as a publication date for the reason recorded on dagupan-lgu-directories.

title: Department Heads — The City section
licence: Copyright © 2023 City Government of Dagupan. All Rights Reserved. (site footer)
notes: The third live roster, in an older table format: no honorifics, no (075) area-code prefix, and a different Management Information System Office email. It names a different person from the other two pages at seven offices (City Health, City Human Resource Management, City Tourism, City Agriculture, Office of Senior Citizens Affairs, One-Stop Business Center, City Information). It is deliberately NOT given a `coverage` period: the only evidence that it is superseded is inferential, and labelling it historical without a document saying so would overstate what is known. It is cited here as corroboration wherever it agrees with the other pages, and as evidence of disagreement wherever it does not. Two of its values are demonstrably wrong against the rest of the site: the City Nutrition Office number "636-9483" transposes the "636-9843" the other two pages give, and the Office of Senior Citizens Affairs is listed with "615-1416", the City Planning and Development Office's own number. CMS article:modified_time 2026-07-14T06:35:24Z — the LATEST of the three rosters, which is why that timestamp cannot be used to rank currency.

title: Team Unliserbisyo Secures Majority Seats in the 2025 Local Elections
licence: Copyright © 2023 City Government of Dagupan. All Rights Reserved. (site footer)
notes: The only genuinely dated source in this dataset: an article the city published on 13 May 2025 reporting the results of the 12 May 2025 local elections, which is why the release date and the reference date differ. It establishes that Belen T. Fernandez was re-elected City Mayor and Dean Bryan "BK" Kua re-elected City Vice Mayor for the 2025–2028 term, and is cited on those two office records in addition to the undated directory pages. It is evidence about those two elected posts only, not about any appointed department head. It separately names a "Karlos Reyna" among the incoming city councillors, which is the reason the /the-city/ roster naming an "Engr. Karlos Reyna IV" as City Tourism Office head is treated as unreliable rather than corroborating.
